mapper.insert: INSERT INTO race (race_name, race_date, race_place, race_distance, race_url, user_no, race_reg_date, city_no) VALUES (#{raceName}, #{raceDate}, #{racePlace}, #{raceDistance}, #{raceUrl}, #{userNo}, #{raceRegDate}, #{cityNo})
mapper.update: UPDATE race SET race_name = #{raceName}, race_date = #{raceDate}, race_place = #{racePlace}, race_distance = #{raceDistance}, race_url = #{raceUrl}, city_no = #{cityNo} WHERE race_no = #{raceNo}
